name: Pro Token unrestricted executor campaign
summary: The Pro executor implementation exposed exec() without the caller allowlist added by the post-incident replacement and without a cadence or batch limit, allowing an untrusted caller to force repeated Pro sales under attacker-controlled pool conditions and extract USDT.
notes: The proxy constructor's Upgraded event selected implementation 0x7fba63d0c45f265c1bea3ed2e49f0691a9d9aa87; this was the sole pre-campaign implementation selection.

Across the 11 successful transactions from the first defect execution through 0xaaea183b...84d0, receipt-level Transfer logs show 57,969.169891681606435859 USDT paid directly by the Pro/USDT pair to attacker EOA 0x427671b2c8e91034a91fe698f9b7259b2345f45d. USDT is valued at stablecoin par. The executor also supplied 167,500 Pro to the forced swaps, while 7,404,304.727660184073717188 USDT went to its three preconfigured receivers; GoPlus identifies those receivers as protocol-designated rather than attacker addresses, so their balances and the exchanged Pro are not counted again. SlowMist's approximately $52,000 figure reflects reported attacker profit rather than this exact gross stablecoin receipt. The later 0x4baf136b...49a50 transaction came from a different EOA and helper and is outside this campaign.
